description: Four-panel figure: insertion energetics, calibrated SP probability, AlphaFold burial profile, and ortholog/paralog comparison for AADACL4
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections, math
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_predict, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
AA="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
S="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
def page(q,size=500,maxrec=4000):
    r=requests.get(S,params={"query":q,"format":"json","size":size},timeout=180); out=[]
    while True:
        j=r.json(); out+=j["results"]
        n=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not n or len(out)>=maxrec: break
        r=requests.get(n,timeout=180)
    return out
res=page("(reviewed:true) AND (organism_id:9606) AND (ft_signal:*) AND (fragment:false)")
EXP=[];ALLSP=[]
for e in res:
    sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
    for f in e.get("features",[]):
        if f["type"]!="Signal": continue
        cds={ev.get("evidenceCode") for ev in f.get("evidences",[])}; en=f["location"]["end"].get("value")
        if en is None or en<15 or en>len(sq)-5: continue
        ALLSP.append((en,sq))
        if "ECO:0000269" in cds: EXP.append((en,sq))
sa=page('(reviewed:true) AND (organism_id:9606) AND (ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor for type II") AND NOT (ft_signal:*) AND (fragment:false)',maxrec=2000)
ANCH=[]
for e in sa:
    sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
    t=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane" and "type II" in f.get("description","")]
    if not t: continue
    st=t[0]["location"]["start"]["value"]
    if st>45 or st<2 or len(sq)<80: continue
    ANCH.append(sq)
bgc=collections.Counter()
for en,sq in ALLSP: bgc.update([c for c in sq[en:] if c in idx])
tot=sum(bgc.values()); bg=np.array([bgc[a]/tot for a in AA])
POS=list(range(-13,0))+[1,2]
def win(sq,si):
    w=[]
    for p in POS:
        i=si+p if p<0 else si+p-1
        if i<0 or i>=len(sq): return None
        w.append(sq[i])
    return "".join(w)
M=np.zeros((len(POS),20)); nt=0
for en,sq in EXP:
    w=win(sq,en)
    if w is None or any(c not in idx for c in w): continue
    nt+=1
    for k,c in enumerate(w): M[k,idx[c]]+=1
P=(M+20*bg)/(nt+20); LO=np.log2(P/bg)
def pwm(sq,si):
    w=win(sq,si)
    if w is None or any(c not in idx for c in w): return np.nan
    return float(sum(LO[k,idx[c]] for k,c in enumerate(w)))
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
HE=dict(A=0.11,C=-0.13,D=3.49,E=2.68,F=-0.32,G=0.74,H=2.06,I=-0.60,K=2.71,L=-0.55,M=-0.10,N=2.05,P=2.23,Q=2.36,R=2.58,S=0.84,T=0.52,V=-0.31,W=0.30,Y=0.68)
kdm=lambda s: sum(KD.get(c,0) for c in s)/max(len(s),1)
dG=lambda s: sum(HE.get(c,0) for c in s)
KR=lambda s: sum(1 for c in s if c in "KR")
def feats(sq):
    L=19; b=None
    for i in range(0,min(45,len(sq)-L)+1):
        v=dG(sq[i:i+L])
        if b is None or v<b[0]: b=(v,i+1,i+L)
    dg,hs,he=b
    cd=[(pwm(sq,t),t) for t in range(max(14,he-5),min(he+12,len(sq)-3)+1)]
    cd=[c for c in cd if not math.isnan(c[0])]
    if not cd: return None
    sc,si=max(cd)
    return dict(dG19=dg,h_start=hs,h_end=he,n_len=hs-1,n_KR=KR(sq[:hs-1]),
                dKR=KR(sq[:hs-1])-KR(sq[he:he+15]),site=si,delta=si-he,pwm=sc,creg_kd=kdm(sq[si-6:si]))
X=[];y=[]
for en,sq in EXP:
    f=feats(sq)
    if f: X.append(f); y.append(1)
for sq in ANCH:
    f=feats(sq)
    if f: X.append(f); y.append(0)
F=pd.DataFrame(X); y=np.array(y)
cols=["dG19","h_start","n_len","n_KR","dKR","delta","pwm","creg_kd"]
clf=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000))
oof=cross_val_predict(clf,F[cols],y,cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0),method="predict_proba")[:,1]
auc=roc_auc_score(y,oof); clf.fit(F[cols],y)
par=requests.get(S,params={"query":"(gene:AADAC OR gene:AADACL2 OR gene:AADACL3 OR gene:AADACL4 OR gene:NCEH1) AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true","format":"json","size":20},timeout=60).json()["results"]
PARA={e.get("genes",[{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value"):e["sequence"]["value"] for e in par}
fam={g:feats(s) for g,s in PARA.items()}
for g in fam: fam[g]["p_SP"]=float(clf.predict_proba(pd.DataFrame([fam[g]])[cols])[:,1])
rr=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/homology/symbol/human/AADACL4",params={"content-type":"application/json","type":"orthologues","sequence":"protein"},timeout=180).json()
ORTH={}
for o in rr["data"][0]["homologies"]:
    if o["type"]!="ortholog_one2one": continue
    s=o["target"]["align_seq"].replace("-","")
    if o["target"]["perc_id"]<45 or not s.startswith("M") or not(350<len(s)<460): continue
    ORTH.setdefault(o["target"]["species"],s)
OF=pd.DataFrame([feats(s) for s in ORTH.values()])
OF["p_SP"]=clf.predict_proba(OF[cols])[:,1]

# ---- AlphaFold burial profile for AADACL4 ----
j=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q5VUY2",timeout=120).json()
pdb=requests.get(j[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
ca={};cb={};pl={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
    at=l[12:16].strip(); rn=int(l[22:26]); xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    if at=="CA": ca[rn]=xyz; pl[rn]=float(l[60:66])
    if at=="CB": cb[rn]=xyz
for rn in ca: cb.setdefault(rn,ca[rn])
Kk=np.array(sorted(cb)); C=np.vstack([cb[i] for i in Kk])
D=np.linalg.norm(C[:,None]-C[None,:],axis=-1); nbr=((D<10)&(D>0)).sum(1)

# ================= FIGURE =================
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
COL={"AADACL4":"#C8102E","AADACL3":"#E87722","AADACL2":"#7A52C7","AADAC":"#1B7F79","NCEH1":"#1F4E9C"}
a=ax[0,0]
a.hist(F.dG19[y==1],bins=40,alpha=.55,color="#8FA8C8",label="verified cleaved signal peptides (n=%d)"%int(y.sum()))
a.hist(F.dG19[y==0],bins=40,alpha=.55,color="#A8C8A0",label="type II signal anchors (n=%d)"%int((1-y).sum()))
for g,v in fam.items(): a.axvline(v["dG19"],color=COL[g],lw=2)
for g,v in fam.items():
    a.text(v["dG19"],a.get_ylim()[1]*(0.95-0.09*list(fam).index(g)),"  "+g,color=COL[g],fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
a.set_xlabel("insertion free energy proxy of best 19-residue window, sum of Hessa values (kcal/mol, lower = more membrane-competent)")
a.set_ylabel("proteins"); a.set_title("a  Hydrophobic-segment insertion energetics"); a.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper right")
b=ax[0,1]
b.hist(oof[y==1],bins=np.linspace(0,1,41),alpha=.55,color="#8FA8C8",label="verified signal peptides")
b.hist(oof[y==0],bins=np.linspace(0,1,41),alpha=.55,color="#A8C8A0",label="type II signal anchors")
for g,v in fam.items(): b.axvline(v["p_SP"],color=COL[g],lw=2)
for g,v in fam.items():
    b.text(v["p_SP"],b.get_ylim()[1]*(0.95-0.09*list(fam).index(g)),"  %s %.2f"%(g,v["p_SP"]),color=COL[g],fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
b.set_xlabel("P(cleaved signal peptide), logistic model, 5-fold CV AUC = %.3f"%auc)
b.set_ylabel("proteins (out-of-fold)"); b.set_title("b  Calibrated signal-peptide probability"); b.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper center")
c=ax[1,0]
c.plot(Kk,nbr,lw=.9,color="#444444")
c.axvspan(5,25,color="#C8102E",alpha=.22); c.axvspan(41,60,color="#E87722",alpha=.22)
c.axhline(np.mean(nbr[(Kk>=110)]),ls="--",color="#1B7F79",lw=1.2)
c.text(13,2,"N-terminal\nsegment 5-25",color="#C8102E",fontsize=9,ha="center",fontweight="bold")
c.text(52,2,"41-60\n(Phobius 2nd TM)",color="#B35900",fontsize=9,ha="center",fontweight="bold")
c.text(300,np.mean(nbr[(Kk>=110)])+1.2,"mean burial of folded domain",color="#1B7F79",fontsize=8)
c.set_xlabel("residue (AADACL4, AlphaFold AF-Q5VUY2-F1)"); c.set_ylabel("CB neighbours within 10 A")
c.set_title("c  The N-terminal helix is detached from the folded domain")
d=ax[1,1]
d.scatter(OF.dG19,OF.p_SP,s=34,color="#8C8C8C",alpha=.8,label="AADACL4 1:1 orthologs (n=%d)"%len(OF))
for g,v in fam.items(): d.scatter(v["dG19"],v["p_SP"],s=120,color=COL[g],edgecolor="k",zorder=5,label=g)
d.axhline(0.5,ls=":",color="k",lw=1)
d.axvline(np.percentile(F.dG19[y==1],5),ls="--",color="#8FA8C8",lw=1.2)
d.text(np.percentile(F.dG19[y==1],5),1.02,"5th pct of verified SPs",fontsize=8,color="#44648C",ha="center")
d.set_xlabel("insertion free energy proxy (kcal/mol)"); d.set_ylabel("P(cleaved signal peptide)")
d.set_title("d  AADAC family and AADACL4 orthologs"); d.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right",ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("CV AUC %.3f"%auc)
print(pd.DataFrame(fam).T[["dG19","h_start","h_end","n_KR","site","delta","pwm","creg_kd","p_SP"]].round(2).to_string())
print("\northologs n=%d  p_SP median %.2f  dG19 median %.2f (verified-SP 5th pct %.2f)"%(len(OF),OF.p_SP.median(),OF.dG19.median(),np.percentile(F.dG19[y==1],5)))
print("fraction of orthologs with dG19 below the verified-SP 5th percentile: %.2f"%( (OF.dG19<np.percentile(F.dG19[y==1],5)).mean()))
